content:
Maria Chen: Hey @eng-infra — quick ask: we have a customer demo next Tue 9am PT that needs 4x A100s in us-west1 for ~2 hours. Any standby pool or vendor slots we can borrow? cc @Kyle Park @Jonathan Li
Kyle Park: We currently have 2 reserved in demo-pool (demo-pool-usw1). Can try to borrow 2 more from our partner. What's the latency requirement for the demo? Also need a billing tag to move forward.
Jonathan Li: I just ran a quick inventory check with vendor-bot — partner has 6x A100s free in us-west1 but they require a quota bump + billing confirmation. I can open a partner support ticket now.
vendor-bot: Inventory query result: region=us-west1, model=A100, available=6. Quota increase required for >2 instances. Soft-hold option available once invoice/payment initiated. Contact: rep@partner.example.com
Priya Sinha: Is a soft-hold guaranteed? We need hold window at least 24h to prep canary. Also, should we consider h100 fallback in case partner can't deliver?
Kyle Park: For this demo we prefer A100s for cost predictability. h100 has more variance in thermal throttling for the workload. If vendor can soft-hold for 24h we're fine. I'll create the billing tag now: project=democtl, cost_center=eng-demos.
Maria Chen: Confirm project=democtl. Jonathan, can you open the ticket and add a note: "soft-hold required 24h, ship on Tue 9am PT, contact on-site: maria@redwood.com"? Also please request early invoice to engage soft-hold.
Jonathan Li: Ticket opened: INC-12345 (partner support). Message included. Summary: request quota bump + soft-hold, invoice early. Vendor reply ETA 48-72h. I added billing tag info and CC'd procurement.
infra-oncall: FYI if partner can't deliver in time, fallback plan is to borrow 2x from dedicated-demo-east (eu-west1) which will add ~80-120ms latency. That will still work for a visual demo but not for a latency-sensitive benchmark.
Priya Sinha: I'll prep a fallback script that redirects traffic to eu-west1 subset and adds a note in the demo UI about increased latency. Will test with 2x A100s in staging later today.
Kyle Park: Action items: Jonathan open ticket (done), Procurement to provision billing/PO, Kyle to add IAM access for vendor service account (will do), Priya prepare fallback routing and test, Maria confirm with PM and customer.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll confirm with PM by EOD. If vendor responds with hold confirmation I'll kick off the invoice flow. :thumbsup:
Jonathan Li: Partner just replied in the ticket: "Can soft-hold 4x A100 for 24h upon invoice initiation. Quota bump processed after billing verification (48h typical)." Forwarding to procurement now.
Kyle Park: I'll add a short PR to infra-terraform to add the vendor SA to democtl project with minimal perms (compute.instanceAdmin maybe narrower). PR link: https://git.internal/repo/pull/422
Priya Sinha: Quick note — if quota bump stalls, we can also do 4x smaller instances (v100-ish) in us-west1 but perf will differ. Documenting tradeoffs in the demo runbook.
infra-oncall: Marking this thread for oncall awareness — I'll subscribe to the partner ticket and ping if we see quota not applied by Tue 04:00 PT.
Maria Chen: Great. Please keep updates here. :raised_hands:
